name: HD 222259B

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list DS Tuc A and HD 222259B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 6387058411482257536 and 6387058411482257280), 237 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 7.2e-8: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to DS Tuc A, 237 AU away.

radius.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the radius of TIC 410214984 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

mass.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the mass of TIC 410214984 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

temperature.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the effective temperature of TIC 410214984 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

text.card: HD 222259B is a star of 4,658 K, bound to DS Tuc A 237 AU away.
text.introduction: HD 222259B shares its motion through space with DS Tuc A, 237 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: HD 222259B's orbit around DS Tuc A is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
